narration.en: A binary search tree keeps smaller values on the left and bigger values on the right of every node.
narration.hi: Binary search tree mein har node ke left side chhote values aur right side bade values hote hain.
narration.hi_speech: Binary search tree में हर node के left side छोटे values और right side बड़े values होते हैं.

narration.en: Let us insert 35. We always start comparing at the root.
narration.hi: Ab 35 insert karte hain. Comparison hamesha root se shuru hota hai.
narration.hi_speech: अब 35 insert करते हैं. Comparison हमेशा root से शुरू होता है.

narration.en: 35 is smaller than 50, so go left to 30. 35 is bigger than 30, so go right to 40.
narration.hi: 35, 50 se chhota hai, toh left jao 30 pe. 35, 30 se bada hai, toh right jao 40 pe.
narration.hi_speech: 35, 50 से छोटा है, तो left जाओ 30 पे. 35, 30 से बड़ा है, तो right जाओ 40 पे.

narration.en: 35 is smaller than 40 and the left of 40 is empty, so 35 becomes its left child.
narration.hi: 35, 40 se chhota hai aur 40 ka left khali hai, toh 35 wahin baith jaata hai.
narration.hi_speech: 35, 40 से छोटा है और 40 का left खाली है, तो 35 वहीं बैठ जाता है.

narration.en: Insertion walks one path from the root, so it costs order h, the height. Balanced trees give log n, skewed trees give n.
narration.hi: Insertion root se ek hi path chalta hai, isliye cost order h hai, yaani height. Balanced tree mein log n, skewed tree mein n.
narration.hi_speech: Insertion root से एक ही path चलता है, इसलिए cost order h है, यानी height. Balanced tree में log n, skewed tree में n.

narration.en: Quick check: an in-order traversal of a BST always comes out sorted.
narration.hi: Quick check: BST ka in-order traversal hamesha sorted aata hai.
narration.hi_speech: Quick check: BST का in-order traversal हमेशा sorted आता है.

actions.text: In-order output is *sorted*, so 35 landed in the right place.

quiz.q: Inserting 65 into this tree, where does it go?
Worst-case insertion cost in a skewed BST?
quiz.why: A skewed tree is a chain, so its height is n.
